ev_b83609f70b.title: Tool-using LLM agent for e-commerce operations staff
ev_b83609f70b.text:
# Tool-using LLM agent for e-commerce operations staff

Short version: staff had to look up the same data across three internal systems. Answered 65% of lookup requests without a person.

The core of it was simple: I built the agent as a graph with a human approval step before any write. The piece that mattered most:

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI(title="ops-agent")


@app.post("/v1/run")
async def run(payload: dict) -> dict:
    return service.handle(payload)
```

Also cut the median lookup from 8 minutes to under 1. Ran 7 weeks for a e-commerce client in 2021.

ev_dfd3b8407a.title: Churn prediction model for a edtech subscription product
ev_dfd3b8407a.text:
# Churn prediction model for a edtech subscription product

*Edtech client · 2021-08 · 14 weeks · hourly*

The retention team could not tell which accounts were about to leave. I was brought in to fix that.

I started by working out what good looked like with the client, then built account-level features from usage and billing events. Next I trained and calibrated a gradient-boosted classifier. Finally, I explained predictions per account so the team trusted the scores.

The result: I reached ROC-AUC of 0.84, and helped retention calls save about 11% of flagged accounts.

Tools: Python, Machine Learning, scikit-learn.
